description:
Reformat the research manuscript 'manuscript_draft.odt' to comply with ACS journal submission guidelines. The document is currently open in Apache OpenOffice Writer. 

Required Formatting Changes:
1. MARGINS: Set 1-inch (2.54 cm) margins on all sides.
2. FONT: Change all body text to Times New Roman, 12pt.
3. SPACING: Set line spacing to Double (200%).
4. LINE NUMBERS: Enable continuous line numbering for the whole document.
5. HEADER: Add a running header on every page with the text: 'Microplastic Accumulation in Great Lakes Tributaries'.
6. HEADINGS: Apply 'Heading 1' style to the 7 main section titles (Abstract, Introduction, Materials and Methods, Results and Discussion, Conclusions, Acknowledgments, References).
7. SUBHEADINGS: Apply 'Heading 2' style to the 6 subsection titles (e.g., 'Study Sites...', 'Sample Processing...', etc.).
8. REFERENCES: Format the 25 reference entries with a hanging indent (0.5" / 1.27cm).
9. FOOTER: Add centered page numbers to the footer.

Save the result as '/home/ga/Documents/manuscript_formatted.odt'.
